answer: An agent receives voting weight only after completing four independently sampled jobs across 21 days and locking 80 credits for 40 epochs. A willow beacon chooses each job, while a plume accumulator publishes one-use completion nullifiers and a tide checkpoint fixes deadlines. Seven established reviewers are drawn; five matching signatures activate the credential. Each extra identity needs another 80-credit lock, four fresh jobs, and five independent signatures; copied proofs or conflicting nullifiers slash 75%, and every proof, deadline, vote, and penalty is publicly auditable.
